movie.title: One More Shot
movie.overview: New Years Eve. 1999. Minnie discovers a bottle of time travelling tequila. Each shot takes her back to the start of the night - giving her a bottle’s worth of shots to win back her old flame Joe, and change the course of her millennium.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: On New Year's Eve 1999, a woman discovers that each shot from a mystical bottle of tequila resets the night, giving her multiple chances to rewrite her past and win back her former flame.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Stuck in a rut on New Year's Eve 1999, mid-30s anesthesiologist Minnie attends a Y2K house party hoping to reunite with her university crush, Joe. Upon arrival, she is crushed to find Joe has brought his new girlfriend, but things take an extraordinary turn when she takes a sip of a rare Mexican tequila. She quickly realizes that every shot resets the night to the moment after her first drink. With a limited supply remaining in the bottle, Minnie uses each time loop to win back Joe, inadvertently sparking romantic and comedic chaos with every attempt.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: On New Year's Eve 1999, Minnie Vernon is feeling unfulfilled in life and love as the world braces for Y2K. Reluctantly attending a friend's costume party, she hopes to reconnect with her former crush, Joe, only to discover he has returned from New York with a pregnant girlfriend named Jenny. Dejected, Minnie downs a shot from a bottle of rare tequila given to her by a friend, only to wake up back at the start of the party. She soon figures out that each shot from the bottle rewinds time to her initial drink, effectively granting her a limited number of 'do-overs' before the bottle runs dry. Minnie launches into a series of increasingly frantic and chaotic attempts to alter events, isolate Joe, and reignite their romance. However, her temporal meddling continuously backfires, resulting in broken noses, ruined friendships, and unexpected personal revelations about her friends' hidden struggles. Eventually, she learns that her host Rodney has also been using a time-loop bottle of his own, forcing Minnie to confront whether she is truly trying to build a future or merely running away from her present. In her final loop, Minnie stops attempting to selfishly manipulate outcomes, chooses honesty and emotional maturity, and finally lets go of her obsession so everyone can move forward into the new millennium.
aiEnrichment.synopsis:
Set against the nostalgic, Y2K-anxious backdrop of New Year's Eve 1999, One More Shot follows Minnie Vernon, a single, overworked anesthesiologist grappling with romantic regrets and a sense of stalled adulthood. When she attends a turn-of-the-millennium house party hosted by her friend Rodney, she harbors faint hopes of rekindling a flame with her former university crush, Joe. However, her romantic dream is instantly crushed when Joe arrives with his new partner, Jenny.

Things take a surreal turn after Minnie drinks from an obscure bottle of Mexican tequila gifted to her by a friend. After a disastrous turn of events at midnight, she takes another swig and suddenly finds herself transported back to the exact moment she took her first shot earlier that evening. Realizing the tequila possesses mystical time-looping properties—and that its power will expire once the bottle is empty—Minnie embarks on a high-stakes series of resets.

With every shot, Minnie tries new strategies to sway Joe, ranging from calculated charm to desperate interventions, but each loop introduces hilarious unexpected consequences and reveals deeper home truths about the people around her. Mixing wild time-travel mechanics, 90s nostagia, and character-driven comedy, the story uses its time-loop premise to explore self-growth, acceptance, and the importance of leaving the past behind as a new era begins.

story_structure.climax: Down to her last available shots, Minnie faces a critical turning point where her calculated attempts culminate in a high-stakes, emotionally honest moment with Joe before her time runs out.
story_structure.conflict: Minnie stumbles upon a bottle of enchanted tequila and learns that drinking a shot resets her back to the start of the evening, handing her a limited number of chances to fix her past mistakes and win back Joe's heart.
story_structure.resolution: Minnie accepts the true lesson of her repeated loops, embracing the ultimate outcome of her choices as the clock strikes midnight on the new millennium.
story_structure.introduction: On New Year's Eve 1999, Minnie prepares to attend a party where her ex-boyfriend Joe will be present, hoping to reconnect with him as the millennium approaches.
story_structure.risingAction: With each reset, Minnie tests new strategies to win Joe over, navigating unexpected complications, chaotic party dynamics, and the rapidly diminishing liquid in the bottle with every trial.
